svg.title: ZooVision — 3RD PLACE / AWS BUILDER LOFT
svg.desc: Overnight animal-welfare monitoring for keepers. Deterministic Python rules own every alert level. Models describe, they never vote on severity. Built with TWELVELABS, PYTHON, SQLITE, NEO4J, LIVE AT ZOOVISION.TECH.
